messages:
Lina: Quick thread : finalize speaker swap protocol + understudy/backups for the Aug webinar. We want a clean producer script for when a speaker drops or a demo fails.
Omar: Good call. Two live demos, 35m total. Plan: primary live demo (browser-friendly), secondary demo recorded but with live commentary. Need a short rulebook: when to swap, who calls it, and how to signal on stream.
Becky: Suggest a "swap matrix" with triggers and actions. Triggers: network stall >45s, auth error, presenter can't join 5m pre-show. Actions: 1) Presenter signals via Slack DM to host. 2) Host triggers pre-roll recorded clip. 3) Understudy (backup speaker) does live commentary + Q.
Connor: Add roles: Host (controls flow), Producer (controls pre-roll + scene switch), Understudy (fallback presenter), Tech lead (fixes creds). Also a visible on-screen banner: "We're switching to recorded demo while we reconnect". Keep banners <20s.
Lina: Concrete swap matrix (short):
```
trigger -> who decides -> action -> timebound
network stall (>45s) -> Producer -> play pre-roll + host explains -> immediate
presenter absent (t-5m) -> Host -> swap to understudy or recorded -> announce + start
demo error (auth/500s) -> Tech -> attempt quick fix 60s, if fail -> play recorded + commentary -> switch
```
Omar: Understudy rules: understudy must be present in rehearsal and can run a 3-min clip + live commentary. We need to lock an understudy for each demo. Can we nominate two people? Becky can understudy demo A; Connor understudy demo B.
Becky: I can do A but request a 30m prep slot with the primary. Also need a short script for commentary in case we jump to recorded clip.
Connor: I'll understudy B and create a 90s "jump-in" script: intro (20s), key takeaway (30s), Q prompt (40s). Put scripts in rehearsal doc.
Lina: Rehearsal schedule proposal: Aug 9 10am PT (NA-friendly) and Aug 11 3pm BST (EU-friendly). Require primary + understudy + host + producer + tech lead. Keep each run 50m.
Omar: Run-of-show compact (35m):
```
00:00-00:03 host intro + housekeeping
00:03-00:14 Demo A (primary live)
00:14-00:20 Demo B (primary live or recorded+commentary)
00:20-00:28 customer vignette + metrics
00:28-00:33 moderated Q
00:33-00:35 CTA + promo code
```
Becky: Lead routing: landing uses utm_campaign=aug_infer_webinar and utm_variant=swap-ready. Tag attendees with attended=true, demo_path=live|recorded, understudy_used=true|false. Routing: attended+asked_q -> sales-priority; attended only -> marketing-nurture.
Connor: Post-event experiments: test two follow-ups: fast (10m auto-email + trial code) vs human (6h short note from solutions rep + trial code). We'll randomize registrants 50/50 and track trial activation 72h.
Lina: Messaging A/B at registration: A) "See a live short demo" B) "Join a compact migration walkthrough". We'll measure registrations -> attendance -> trial. Conversion target: 7% attended->trial (stretch).
Omar: Tech checklist for rehearsal: stable staging key (read-only), demo dataset URLs, pre-roll clips uploaded, slide deck in single PDF, jump-in scripts for understudies, browser tested (Chrome). Add a short constraints table per speaker (needs VPN? special hardware?).
rehearsal-bot: Reminder cadence set: 7d / 72h / 24h / 1h. Will post RSVP counts to #marketing every 12h starting 7 days out. Speaker checklist will be posted 7 days before first dry-run. :robot_face:
Becky: Failure scripts for host (20s): "We're switching to a short recorded clip while we sort a tech issue. We'll be back in under two minutes and will answer live questions after." Keep tone calm and confident.
Connor: Also add internal signal flow: Host types `!swap demoA` in Slack channel to notify producer and ops-bot; ops-bot will trigger pre-roll and display banner. Can ops-bot do that?
rehearsal-bot: Yes, I support `!swap <demo>` command to publish banners and start pre-roll if authorized. Will need producer approval role.
Lina: Action items: 1) Omar lock understudies with primaries today. 2) Becky upload jump-in script + pre-roll for demo A by Aug 1. 3) Connor create tech checklist and `!swap` validation flow. 4) Producer assign and confirm with ops-bot.
Omar: I'll confirm understudies and post a short matrix to /marketing/webinars.
Becky: I'll draft the host fallback script and upload clips.
Lina: If we have speakers & understudies locked by EOD Fri we can run first dry-run Aug 9. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
